## Findings
- claim-1: \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) has integral Schur basis indexed by partitions in \((n-r)^r\), and \(G_L=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}\) generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]
- claim-2: The requested graded-kernel certificate for \(G_L\) is established, using accepted task 292 for the large-\(N\) descent.
## Strategy
Let \(q=n-r\), \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\), and
\[
\mathcal P=\{\rho:\rho\subseteq b^a\},\qquad
F:=\bigoplus_{\rho\in\mathcal P}\mathbb Z e_\rho,\quad
\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|.
\]
Put \(g_\rho=\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}\). The \(g_\rho\) are homogeneous, and source-backed generation of \(J_v\) by \(G_L=\{g_\rho\}\) gives a graded integral surjection
\[
\pi:F\twoheadrightarrow Q,\qquad e_\rho\mapsto[g_\rho].
\]
[doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]

Assume \(a>0\), and let
\[
0\ne x=\sum_{|\beta|=N}c_\beta e_\beta\in\ker\pi
\]
be homogeneous. For \(N>0\),
\[
\sum_{|\beta|=N}c_\beta g_\beta\in A_+J_v.
\]
Since \(J_v=\sum_{\lambda\subseteq b^a}Ag_\lambda\),
\[
A_+J_v=\sum_{\lambda\subseteq b^a}A_+g_\lambda.
\]
Taking the homogeneous component of degree \(ij+N\) yields the source-form syzygy
\[
\sum_{|\beta|=N}c_\beta g_\beta
=
\sum_{\substack{\lambda\subseteq b^a\\|\lambda|<N}}
f_\lambda g_\lambda,
\qquad
f_\lambda\in A_{N-|\lambda|}.
\tag{1}
\]
The strict inequality holds because \(f_\lambda\in A_+\).

Each \((i^j,\beta)\) lies in \(q^r\): its width is at most \(q\), since \(i\le q\), and its length is at most \(j+a\le r\). Thus the \(g_\beta\) are distinct members of the integral Schur basis of \(A\). Hence the left side of (1) is nonzero.

Expanding every \(f_\lambda\) in the Schur basis gives precisely the full-coordinate linear system of the source construction, with wide right sides \(0\) and tall right side \(c_\beta\) for the tall partition associated to \(\beta\). The accepted task-292 integral descent applies coefficientwise: every tall row is an integral combination of original wide rows, retaining all variables. Therefore every tall right side vanishes, so every \(c_\beta=0\), contradicting \(x\ne0\). Hence \(\ker\pi=0\) in positive \(N\).

For \(N=0\), only \(\rho=\varnothing\) occurs. Since \(J_v\) is generated by classes of degree at least \(ij\),
\[
(A_+J_v)_{ij}=0.
\]
As \(g_\varnothing=\bar s_{i^j}\ne0\) is a Schur-basis class, \(\pi(ce_\varnothing)=0\) implies \(c=0\).

If \(a=0\), then \(\mathcal P=\{\varnothing\}\), so the preceding \(N=0\) argument applies directly. Thus \(\pi\) is injective also in this case.

Consequently the requested graded-kernel certificate is established, conditional on accepted task 292:
\[
Q\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z\,[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
\]

## Gaps
None, conditional on the accepted task-292 full-coordinate integral tall-to-wide descent.

## Next
